info.title: Contigo API
info.description:
Contract for the Contigo backend API (backend/src/Contigo.Api), consumed by the web (this file) and mobile (ADR-013) TypeScript clients per ADR-012's "single OpenAPI document -> one generated TypeScript client, no hand-written divergent DTOs" rule (see reports/architecture/draft/client-architect/api-consumption.md #1).

Provenance / interim status (task E01/F07/US01/T02): the API host does not yet self-publish this document -- no Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi / Swashbuckle / NSwag is wired into backend/src/Contigo.Api/Program.cs as of this task, and adding that is outside this task's file scope (the web client only; this task's frontmatter is target_repo: contigo-web). Until a backend task adds self-published OpenAPI generation, this file is hand-authored to describe exactly the routes Program.cs actually implements today, cross-checked against backend/tests/Contigo.Api.Tests. It is the single file `npm run generate:api` (web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs) reads to produce web/src/api/generated/schema.ts, and must grow endpoint-by-endpoint as backend/src/Contigo.Api/Program.cs grows -- then be replaced outright once the API self-publishes its own document.

URL versioning (OQ-client-007 in reports/open-questions.md, still `open` at council-close: "OpenAPI codegen tool and URL versioning scheme ... owned by software-architect") is deliberately NOT applied to the paths below: Program.cs maps bare `/health`, not `/v1/health`, and a client generated against a path the API does not actually serve would 404 in every real environment. `info.version` above tracks this document's own revision; add a URL path prefix here only once software-architect fixes one and Program.cs actually serves it under that prefix.

Codegen tool choice (also part of OQ-client-007, resolved here for this task rather than left blocking it, per reports/open-questions.md's "add an entry, state the assumption, build against it"): third-party OpenAPI-to-TypeScript generators evaluated at authoring time (openapi-typescript@7.13.0, which peer-depends on `typescript@^5.x`) hard-conflict with this repo's already-committed `typescript@^7.0.2` (web/package.json, task E01/F07/US01/T01) under npm's default strict peer resolution. Rather than force an incorrect peer resolution (`--legacy-peer-deps`/`--force`) or downgrade a previous task's already-committed TypeScript version, this contract is compiled by a small first-party generator (web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs, zero new dependencies) that reads this JSON file and emits the `paths`/`operations` TypeScript types the same way the mainstream tools shape them. Swap in a third-party tool once one publishes TypeScript-7-compatible peer ranges; the generated *output shape* (`paths`/`operations`) is deliberately kept compatible with that ecosystem convention so the swap is mechanical.

Task E06/F01/US01/T01 (typescript-client-regen) added the four operations below beyond `/health`: `POST /api/workspaces` (create), `POST /api/workspaces/{tenantId}/invites` (invite), `POST /api/documents` (upload), `GET /api/documents/{id}` (read back) -- exactly epic-06-web-foundation's own R0 scope ("the sign-in -> workspace picker flow ... and the R0 surfaces (members & roles, document upload, document-status read-back)"). backend/src/Contigo.Api/Program.cs now also maps many more routes added by backend epics E02-E05 (GET /api/contracts, GET/PATCH /api/contracts/{id}, GET /api/contracts/{id}/corrections, GET /api/audit, GET /api/renewals and /api/renewals/{contractId}/priority, POST /api/renewals/{id}/action, GET/PATCH /api/savings and GET /api/savings/kpis, POST /api/chat/query, POST /api/quotes and GET /api/quotes/{id}/assessment, POST /api/negotiations/outcomes) that this task deliberately did NOT add here: epic-06-web-foundation's own "Out of scope" list names exactly that set ("portfolio, Contract 360, review, Ask, renewals, savings, quote check -- later web epics"), and feature-01-typescript-client-regen's own "Council decisions carried into this story" calls this a "Repeating chore" -- whichever web epic first builds a screen against one of those endpoints should extend this file next, the same way this task extended the `/health`-only version task E01/F07/US01/T02 left behind. Nullable fields (e.g. a freshly-uploaded or not-yet-classified document's `contractId`) use OpenAPI 3.1's `type: [X, "null"]` union instead of a bolted-on `nullable: true` flag; web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs gained one small, additive case for it (a `type` array renders as the equivalent TypeScript union, plus a case for `object`/`properties` -- every new response below is a flat, single-level object) -- see that script's own comments on the change.

Task E07/F03/US01/T01 (field-review-correction, ADR-020 screen 6) added `PATCH /api/contracts/{id}` (`correctContract`) and `GET /api/contracts/{id}/corrections` (`getCorrectionHistory`) -- the third web epic to extend this document (task E07/F01/US01/T01 was the first, task E07/F02/US01/T01 the second; see this paragraph's own 'repeating chore' provenance note above). Both operations were already implemented by backend task E02/F05/US01/T01/T02 (us-01-correction-history) and already named in this document's own provenance paragraph's backend-routes list ('GET/PATCH /api/contracts/{id}, GET /api/contracts/{id}/corrections') as not yet documented here -- this task closes that gap, it does not add new backend behaviour. Both response/request bodies use the same plain-object/array shapes generate-api-client.mjs already supports; no generator change was needed.

Task E08/F01/US01/T01 (renewal-pipeline, ADR-020 screen 8) added `POST /api/renewals/{id}/action` (`postRenewalAction`) -- the fourth web epic to extend this document (task E07/F01/US01/T01 was the first, E07/F02/US01/T01 the second, E07/F03/US01/T01 the third; see this paragraph's own 'repeating chore' provenance note above). This operation was already named in this document's own provenance paragraph's backend-routes list ('POST /api/renewals/{id}/action') as not yet documented here -- this task closes that gap, it does not add new backend behaviour. Already implemented by backend task E03/F03/US01/T02 (renewal-action). The 200 response's `status` field is a real, closed three-value enum (NotStarted/InProgress/Completed, RenewalActionStatus.ToString()) so it is declared with `enum` the same way GET /api/renewals's own `status` field already is -- generate-api-client.mjs renders it as a TypeScript string-literal union with no generator change needed. The request body (owner/status/action, all free-form strings on the wire) is hand-written in src/api/client.ts, like every other write operation's request type in this document -- the generator does not parse `requestBody` at all (see this file's own 'Codegen tool choice' paragraph above).

Task E08/F03/US01/T01 (quote-check-ui, ADR-018 route /quotes/:id, ADR-020 screen 10) adds the four operations this document's own provenance paragraph above named as deliberately deferred: `POST /api/quotes` (uploadQuote), `GET /api/quotes/{id}/assessment` (getQuoteAssessment), `POST /api/quotes/{id}/assessment/recalculate` (recalculateQuoteAssessment), and `POST /api/negotiations/outcomes` (captureNegotiationOutcome) -- the fourth and, for this document, last web epic to extend this file (task E07/F01/US01/T01 was the first, E07/F02/US01/T01 the second, E07/F03/US01/T01 the third; see this paragraph's own 'repeating chore' provenance note above). All four operations were already implemented by backend epic E05 (Contigo.Quotes module, wired into Program.cs via AddQuotesModule/MapQuotesEndpoints/MapNegotiationsEndpoints) before this task started; this task only documents and wraps them, it does not add new backend behaviour. `position` (Contigo.Quotes.Domain.MarketPosition) is deliberately typed as a bare nullable string, not a nullable enum -- the same generate-api-client.mjs#renderSchemaType 'enum drops the null union member' limitation getPortfolio's own `risk` field and Contract 360's `header.risk`/`clauses[].riskLevel` already worked around; web/src/api/client.ts names the real 3-value set as its own hand-written `QuoteMarketPosition` alias plus an `isQuoteMarketPosition` guard, the same pattern `PortfolioRiskSeverity`/`isPortfolioRiskSeverity` already establish. `GET /api/quotes/{id}/assessment` and `POST /api/quotes/{id}/assessment/recalculate` share an identical per-line assessment shape, duplicated rather than `$ref`'d (the generator has no `$ref`/`oneOf` support -- see its own header comment). Two operations' 404s carry a real string body (`Results.NotFound(result.Error)`, not the bare empty-body `Results.NotFound()` every earlier 404 in this document uses) -- documented with `content` accordingly, and web/src/api/client.ts reads that body instead of fabricating a generic not-found message, unlike its own earlier 404 handlers. `Contigo.Quotes.Application.Strategy.NegotiationStrategyService` (negotiation-lever recommendations + evidence, task E05/F03/US01/T01) has no HTTP endpoint anywhere in `Program.cs` -- a genuine, pre-existing backend gap this task's `contigo-web` file scope cannot close; `POST /api/negotiations/outcomes`'s own description above names it, and web/src/routes/quotes/ renders an honest gap notice in its place rather than inventing lever evidence to match the cited prototype's own fixture data.

Task E08/F02/US01/T01 (savings-home, ADR-020 screen 9) adds `GET /api/savings/kpis` (getSavingsKpis) and the GET half of `/api/savings` (getSavingsOpportunities) -- the fifth web epic to extend this document (task E07/F01/US01/T01 was the first, E07/F02/US01/T01 the second, E07/F03/US01/T01 the third, E08/F01/US01/T01 the fourth; see this paragraph's own 'repeating chore' provenance note above). Both operations were already named in this document's own provenance paragraph's backend-routes list ('GET/PATCH /api/savings and GET /api/savings/kpis') as not yet documented here; this task closes the GET half of that gap (already implemented by backend tasks E04/F02/US02/T01, E04/F03/US01/T01, E04/F03/US01/T02), it does not add new backend behaviour. `PATCH /api/savings/{id}` stays undocumented -- no screen in this task's own AC needs it (Home is read-only), so it is left for whichever future task first builds a real caller, the same 'wiring lands with the first real caller' convention this codebase already follows elsewhere. `confidenceLevel`/`status` are real, closed enums (SavingsConfidenceLevel.ToString() / SavingsOpportunityStatus.ToString()) declared with `enum`, the same way GET /api/renewals's own `status` field already is; `getSavingsKpis` never calls Contigo.Benchmark directly (it only aggregates Documents/Contracts and Savings data already at rest), so the Home screen's own 'benchmark provider unreachable' state (screens.md #9) is this call failing for any reason, not a status this endpoint reserves for that specific cause.

This task also found src/api/generated/schema.ts (the committed, supposedly-generated file `npm run generate:api` regenerates from this document) missing the closing brace for its top-level `operations` interface -- a pre-existing defect unrelated to this task's own two new operations, left by an earlier task that could not run the generator in this same harness (no `node`/`npm` on PATH; see AGENTS/CLAUDE instructions) and hand-appended its own operation block without re-closing the interface. Fixed in the same pass as this task's own additions rather than left to break every later task's `tsc --noEmit`.

Task E13/F09/US01/T03 (web-documents-v2, epic-13/feature-09 phase-3) adds `GET /api/documents` (listDocuments), `GET /api/documents/{id}/preview` (getDocumentPreview), `POST /api/documents/{id}/reprocess` (reprocessDocument), `DELETE /api/documents/{id}` (deleteDocument), the 413/415/422 responses on `POST /api/documents`, and widens `documentType` (Quote, Invoice, PriceList, Nda, Dpa alongside the original Msa/OrderForm/Sow/Amendment/RenewalLetter/Other) on every operation that already declared it. This task's own wave-spec `depends_on: [documents-v2-api, web-shell-v2]` -- the backend counterpart (epic-13/feature-04, tasks E13/F04/US01/T01 documents-admission and E13/F04/US01/T02 documents-v2-api) had not actually landed in this worktree when this task ran (checked: no `Documents:AdmissionThreshold`/`DocumentsEndpointExtensions.cs`/`DocumentAdmissionGate`/reprocess-or-preview-or-delete endpoint exists anywhere under `backend/` as of this commit, despite both backend tasks' own workitem files claiming exactly this surface). Rather than halt the whole web phase on an unmet upstream dependency this task cannot itself close, this document is authored directly from `inputs/requirements.md` §5.1/§6 (the named authoritative source both this task's own text and task-02-documents-v2-api.md's own text point to: "the phase-3 web task documents these endpoints from inputs/requirements.md §6") plus the two backend tasks' own workitem files for field names/algorithms neither requirements.md nor an ADR pins exactly (e.g. `DocumentProcessingSummary`'s real field set for the reprocess response, `ISupplierNameLookup`'s nullability for `supplierName`). Every new operation's own `description` above names this provenance individually. Widening the `documentType` enum is scoped to the Documents-only operations above (`listDocuments`, `getDocument`, `reprocessDocument`'s response) -- `getPortfolio`'s `items[].type` and `getContract360`'s `header.type`/`tabs.documents[].documentType` keep the original 6-member set, since Portfolio and Contract 360 are outside this task's own screens and widening their enums without also updating those already-shipped screens' own exhaustive-looking switches would be an uncalled-for, untested ripple; a future task that gives Portfolio/Contract 360 the same widened vocabulary can do so deliberately. When the backend tasks above do land, whichever lands last should diff its own real response shapes against this document rather than assume a silent match.

Task E13/F09/US01/T04 (web-ask-v2, epic-13/feature-09 phase-4) adds `GET/POST /api/conversations`, `GET /api/conversations/{id}`, `POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages` (the ADR-024 §6 reply contract), `GET /api/capabilities`, `GET /api/market/records/{id}` -- the sixth web epic to extend this document (see this paragraph's own 'repeating chore' provenance note above) -- plus `GET /api/insights/criticality` and `GET /api/contracts/{id}/strategy` (documented for completeness, no client.ts wrapper; see each operation's own description), and a `supplierName` property on getPortfolio's / getContract360's / getRenewals' response items (R-SUP-04; already real on listDocuments since task E13/F09/US01/T03). Every new operation's own description names its exact provenance; two are worth flagging here: `GET /api/market/records/{id}`'s real backend handler (backend/src/Contigo.Api/MarketEndpointExtensions.cs) does not compile as of this commit (two concatenated method bodies, confirmed by reading the file directly), so this operation is authored from the clean domain types underneath it, not the broken handler; and the existing `askContigo` operation below (`POST /api/chat/query`) still documents the pre-ADR-024 `{question,intent,canDetermine,answer,citations,message}` shape that ChatEndpointExtensions.cs's own doc comment says was 'replaced entirely' -- left untouched here since this task's own web screens (web/src/routes/ask/**) no longer call it at all, replaced by the conversations endpoints above; a future task that removes the V1 alias and its stale documentation together can close that gap.

servers.description: Relative to the runtime-configured API origin (AppConfig.apiBaseUrl, ADR-012 "config, not code"; see web/src/config/appConfig.ts). This document intentionally does not hard-code a dev/demo host.

get.description: Maps 1:1 to `app.MapHealthChecks("/health")` in backend/src/Contigo.Api/Program.cs, which registers no custom HealthCheckOptions.ResponseWriter -- so it uses ASP.NET Core's default plain-text writer (Content-Type: text/plain, body is just the status name) rather than a JSON body. The 200-on-healthy case is verified by backend/tests/Contigo.Api.Tests/DeployableApiTests.cs (Health_endpoint_returns_200_ok); the Degraded/Unhealthy cases follow Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks' documented default status-code mapping (Healthy/Degraded -> 200, Unhealthy -> 503), which this repo has not overridden.

200.description: Healthy or Degraded.

post.description:
Maps 1:1 to CreateWorkspaceAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/WorkspaceEndpointExtensions.cs (task E01/F09/US01/T01, r0-integration), backed by WorkspaceProvisioningService.CreateWorkspaceAsync (backend/src/Contigo.Identity.Workspace/Infrastructure/WorkspaceProvisioningService.cs). The pre-authentication signup step -- nobody has a tenant claim yet, by definition -- so (unlike every other operation below) this one takes no X-Tenant-Id header. Task E06/F03/US01/T01 (us-01-signin-workspace-picker, AC-1 'Create a new workspace') is the first web caller of this already-implemented backend endpoint.

Interim, pre-authentication endpoint: ADR-010's JWT/claims wiring is not yet in force (see that endpoint file's own doc comment), so there is no caller identity to attach as the new workspace's first member -- creating a workspace does not create a membership for the caller (WorkspaceProvisioningService only inserts the WorkspaceTenant + its seeded WorkspaceRole catalog, never a WorkspaceMembership row). No `GET` (list-workspaces-for-caller) endpoint exists yet anywhere in backend/src/Contigo.Api -- web/src/routes/signin/workspaceStore.ts documents the client-side interim this drives and exactly which backend types would need a list query added.

name.description: Workspace display name. WorkspaceProvisioningService.CreateWorkspaceAsync trims it and fails (400) if blank.

id.description: WorkspaceTenant.TenantId.Value (a Guid) -- also the workspace row's own Id (WorkspaceTenant's `Id == TenantId` invariant).

400.description: Blank name, or another validation failure surfaced via WorkspaceProvisioningService.CreateWorkspaceAsync's Result<T>.Error (a plain string, serialized as a JSON string body by Results.BadRequest).

post.summary: Invite a member into a workspace with a role.
post.description: Maps to WorkspaceEndpointExtensions.InviteAsync (task E01/F09/US01/T01). The target tenant comes from the route, not a caller claim (ADR-010/Entra ID is not wired into this host yet) -- no X-Tenant-Id header here either, for the same reason.

400.description: Missing/invalid route tenantId, blank email, unrecognized role, or WorkspaceMembershipService.InviteAsync's Result.Error.

post.description: Maps to the inline handler in Program.cs (task E01/F06/US01/T01 upload; task E02/F06/US01/T01 adds the synchronous parse -> classify -> extract pipeline before responding). Interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder pending ADR-010 claim-based tenant resolution -- see Program.cs's own comment on this endpoint for why this gap is not yet promoted to reports/open-questions.md.

201.description: Admitted by the gate, stored, and processed synchronously; `contractId` is null only when the pipeline itself failed after the upload was already durable. `mimeType` is the sniffed canonical type (`application/pdf`, the two OOXML types, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`), never the browser's declared `Content-Type`. `processingStatus` reflects the pipeline's own run (task E02/F06/US01/T01), which reuses the parse and classification the admission gate already computed -- the classify role is called once per upload.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, a non-multipart body, an empty/missing 'file' field, or DocumentUploadService.UploadAsync's Result.Error.

413.description: Task E13/F04/US01/T01 (documents-admission): file exceeds `Documents:MaxFileBytes` (50 MB), rejected before any parse or AI-gateway call -- both the declared `Content-Length` and the received part are checked (`Contigo.Api.DocumentsEndpointExtensions`). Plain-string body, same `Results.Json(string)` shape as the 415 below and the 400 above.

application/json.example: Contigo accepts files up to 50 MB. This file is larger.

415.description: Task E13/F04/US01/T01: format rejected by extension **and** magic-byte sniffing (`Contigo.Documents.Contracts.Application.Admission.DocumentFormatSniffer`) before any parse or AI-gateway call -- a `.zip` renamed `.pdf` lands here, never a 422 (R-DOC-02 AC-1), and so does a PNG renamed `.pdf`. Accepted: `.pdf` (`%PDF-` header), `.docx`/`.xlsx` (OOXML package holding `word/document.xml` / `xl/workbook.xml`), `.png`, `.jpg`/`.jpeg`. Plain-string body, quoted verbatim from `inputs/requirements.md` R-DOC-02.

application/json.example: Contigo reads PDF, Word, Excel and scanned images

422.description: Task E13/F04/US01/T01: the admission gate (`DocumentAdmissionGate`) rejected this document *after* parse/OCR and classification but *before* any blob or `document`/`embedding` row was written (ADR-024 "gate before persistence") -- ADR-024's own structured body, `inputs/requirements.md` §6. `reason` is `not_a_contract` (classified type is `Other`, or confidence < `Documents:AdmissionThreshold`) or `no_readable_text` (parsed/OCR'd text below `Documents:MinReadableChars`) -- never both. `detectedType` uses the same widened enum GET /api/documents/{id} and GET /api/documents below use. The web client (task E13/F09/US01/T03) maps `reason` onto the requirements' own longer rejection copy for the "Not added" card; `hint` is the shorter, backend-owned fragment that copy quotes.

confidence.description: The classify role's own confidence, 0-1. Always present, even for `no_readable_text` (0 -- classify never ran; see DocumentAdmissionGate).

hint.example: Contigo only keeps contracts, order forms, quotes and the documents around them.

get.summary: List the tenant's documents (server-side, survives a reload).
get.description: Task E13/F09/US01/T03 (web-documents-v2), documenting `inputs/requirements.md` R-DOC-06/R-DOC-09/§6 and `Contigo.Documents.Contracts.Application.DocumentQueryService.ListAsync`'s own planned shape (task-02-documents-v2-api.md point 3) ahead of that backend task actually landing in this worktree -- see this document's own top-level provenance note. Replaces the web's own `sessionStorage`-tracked list (`documentStore.ts`); AC-1 "reloading the browser shows the same list as before" depends on this call, not client storage. `status` filters to one exact `processingStatus` value when supplied (the same single-status convention `GET /api/contracts?status=` already uses) -- Documents V2's own "Needs your attention" vs "All documents" toggle is **not** this parameter (attention is a union of three statuses); the web client fetches the tenant's whole list unfiltered and buckets client-side (`documentsListViewModel.ts`), the same fetch-once/filter-local architecture `GET /api/contracts` already established for Portfolio.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact match on Document.ProcessingStatus. Omit to return every status (the web client's own default read).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Defaults to 25; same 100-row ceiling convention `GET /api/contracts` already documents.

200.description: Tenant-scoped document list, newest-created-first.

supplierName.description: Resolved via `ISupplierNameLookup` (F03/T01, same phase) when registered; null otherwise -- never a raw supplier id.

stage.description: R-DOC-09's real stage name (`Uploading` | `Classifying` | `OCR / text` | `Sections & tables` | `Extracting facts` | `Validating schema`), present only while `processingStatus` is `Processing`; null once terminal (or before processing has started). Not declared with `enum` alongside the nullable union -- see this document's own `getPortfolio` operation for why (generate-api-client.mjs#renderSchemaType drops the null member when both are combined).

pageCount.description: Null until the hybrid parse stage has run at least once.

weakFactCount.description: Fields below the review threshold (spec §7.3), 0 once validated or for a document with none. Drives the row action's real "Review N fields" count (screens-v2.md #3).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a malformed status/page query parameter.

get.summary: Read back one document's metadata and processing status.
get.description: Maps to the inline handler in Program.cs (task E01/F06/US01/T02). Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as POST /api/documents. Task E13/F04/US01/T01 widens `documentType` below (5 new admitted types beyond the original 6-member set; existing names unchanged) -- see the `/api/documents` GET (`listDocuments`) operation above for the same widened set and its own provenance note.

200.description: Document found for this tenant.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a non-GUID id in the route.

404.description: No such document for this tenant.

delete.summary: Delete a document (Admin only): blob, preview, row, embeddings; detaches the contract link.
delete.description: Task E13/F04/US01/T02 (documents-v2-api), documented ahead of that backend task landing in this worktree -- see this document's own top-level provenance note; shape from `inputs/requirements.md` R-DOC-10/§6. Audits `document.deleted`. Same interim `X-Tenant-Id`/role posture as every other operation above (ADR-022) -- role is carried as `X-Workspace-Role` the same way the existing admin-only member-management checks already read it (`RequireRole.tsx` on the web side; no header is added here beyond what those checks already assume).

403.description: Caller is not Admin (Procurement gets 403, R-DOC-10).

404.description: No such document for this tenant.

get.summary: First-page preview PNG (or an honest placeholder for DOCX/XLSX), tenant-scoped.
get.description: Task E13/F04/US01/T02, documented ahead of that backend task landing in this worktree -- see this document's own top-level provenance note; shape from `inputs/requirements.md` R-DOC-08/§6. Always `image/png` on 200 regardless of source document type (ADR-009 "never a raw blob URL" -- always proxied through this endpoint, never a Storage URL). The web client (`getDocumentPreviewUrl`) fetches this with the `X-Tenant-Id` header (a plain `` cannot carry a custom header) and turns the response into a browser object URL -- see `src/api/client.ts`'s own doc comment on that method.

200.description: PNG of page 1 (PDF/images) or a generated placeholder (DOCX/XLSX).

404.description: No such document for this tenant.

post.summary: Re-run hybrid parse + embedding (Admin only) so retrieval never cites raw bytes.
post.description: Task E13/F04/US01/T02, documented ahead of that backend task landing in this worktree -- see this document's own top-level provenance note; shape from `inputs/requirements.md` R-DOC-07/§6, mirroring `Contigo.Documents.Contracts.Application.Extraction.DocumentProcessingSummary`'s own real fields (`DocumentReprocessService.ReprocessAsync`'s planned return value, task-02-documents-v2-api.md point 4) rather than an invented response shape. Same interim role posture as `deleteDocument` above.

200.description: Re-parsed and re-embedded; every new embedding row carries a page number (R-DOC-07 AC-2).

404.description: No such document for this tenant.

get.summary: List the tenant's contract portfolio (filters + paging).
get.description:
Maps to GetPortfolioAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/PortfolioEndpointExtensions.cs (task E02/F03/US01/T01 filters; T02 paging), backed by PortfolioQueryService.GetPortfolioAsync. Task E07/F01/US01/T01 (us-01-portfolio-list-filters) adds this operation -- the first web epic to build a screen against one of the E02-E05 backend routes this document's own provenance paragraph already named as outstanding. Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation above (ADR-010 is not wired into Program.cs yet).

The 200 response's risk field is deliberately typed below as a bare nullable string, not a nullable enum, even though the real wire values are exactly Low/Medium/High/Critical or null (RiskSeverity.ToString(), or null when a contract has no recorded risk row). web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs#renderSchemaType checks a schema's enum before it checks whether type is an array -- every enum this document declared before this task was always non-nullable, so a schema combining both never came up, and the generator silently drops the null member when they are combined. Rather than patch the generator (outside this task's own file scope -- the portfolio screen, not the codegen tool), this operation's risk schema omits enum so the generator's existing, already-correct type-array branch produces the honest string-or-null TypeScript type; src/api/client.ts names the real four-value set as its own hand-written PortfolioRiskSeverity alias, with a runtime check at the one place a raw string crosses into it.

parameters.name: supplierId
parameters.description: Exact-match Contract.SupplierId (a bare cross-module id -- Suppliers/Products has no name to filter by yet).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact, case-sensitive match against Contract.Status -- a free-text field (bootstrap default is the literal string processing; otherwise whatever the metadata extraction stage last wrote), not a closed enum yet.

parameters.name: renewalFrom
parameters.description: Only ever matches an auto-renewing contract's EndDate -- PortfolioListItem.RenewalDate is null otherwise.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Defaults to 25; PortfolioPageRequest.MaxPageSize caps it at 100.

200.description: Tenant-scoped portfolio page, newest-created-first, already risk-joined.

supplierName.description: The supplier's display name, resolved from `supplierId` through `ISupplierNameLookup` in one batched call per page -- never a raw supplier id (R-SUP-04, ADR-024). Null when the contract has no supplier, and also when the id no longer resolves for this tenant: the lookup port never fabricates a placeholder name, so a dangling link reads as an id with no name rather than silently losing both. Projected by PortfolioEndpointExtensions.GetPortfolioAsync (task E13/F03/US01/T02); the property was documented here one task earlier (E13/F09/US01/T04) while the backend still only carried the id.

renewalDate.description: Equals endDate only when autoRenewal is true; otherwise null (PortfolioListItem.cs).

risk.description: Low, Medium, High, or Critical, or null when the contract has no recorded Risk row. Deliberately not declared as an enum here -- see this operation's own description for why.

totalCount.description: Rows matching every filter including risk, across all pages -- not just items.length.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a malformed filter/page query parameter (PortfolioEndpointExtensions.TryParseFilter/TryParsePage).

get.summary: Contract 360 aggregate: header plus all ten screens.md #5 tabs.
get.description: Maps to GetContract360Async in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ContractsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by Contract360QueryService (task E02/F03/US02/T01, us-02-contract-360-aggregate). Task E07/F02/US01/T01 (contract-360, ADR-020 screen 5) adds this operation -- the second web epic to extend this document beyond the R0/portfolio set (see this document's own 'repeating chore' provenance paragraph above; task E07/F01/US01/T01 was the first). Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation above. 'benchmark' and 'activity' are always empty arrays this wave (Contigo.Benchmark has no provider adapter until R3; no activity/timeline source is wired yet) -- present as empty arrays, never an omitted key, so the client never has to special-case a missing tab. header.risk and tabs.clauses[].riskLevel are deliberately typed as a bare nullable string, not a nullable enum, for the exact reason this document's getPortfolio operation above already states (generate-api-client.mjs#renderSchemaType drops the null member when enum and a nullable type union are combined); tabs.risks[].severity IS declared as a real non-nullable enum since Contract360Risk.Severity is required, so the generator's bug does not apply there.

200.description: Contract found for this tenant.

supplierName.description: The supplier's display name, resolved from `supplierId` through `ISupplierNameLookup` -- never a raw supplier id (R-SUP-04, ADR-024). Null when the contract has no supplier or the id no longer resolves for this tenant. Projected by ContractsEndpointExtensions.GetContract360Async (task E13/F03/US01/T02); read straight off the generated type by web/src/routes/contracts/contract360/contract360ViewModel.ts#resolveSupplierLabel, which falls back to an id fragment on null rather than fabricating a name. See getPortfolio's identical supplierName property above for the full ISupplierNameLookup provenance.

renewalDate.description: Equals endDate only when autoRenewal is true (Contract360Header.cs).

risk.description: Low, Medium, High, or Critical, or null when the contract has no recorded Risk row. Deliberately not declared as an enum here -- see this operation's own description for why.

lineItemAnnualCostTotal.description: Null only when there are zero line items; a line item with a missing per-line cost contributes zero (Contract360QueryService.cs).

riskLevel.description: Low, Medium, High, or Critical, or null. Deliberately not an enum -- see this operation's own description.

benchmark.description: Always empty this wave -- Contigo.Benchmark has no provider adapter until R3 (Contract360BenchmarkEntry has no members yet).

activity.description: Always empty this wave -- no activity/timeline source is wired yet (R3/R4).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a non-GUID id in the route.

404.description: No such contract for this tenant (or it belongs to a different tenant -- Contract360QueryService cannot and does not distinguish the two, ADR-009).

patch.summary: Record a human correction to one or more extracted Contract fields as a new version.
patch.description: Maps to CorrectContractAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ContractsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by ContractCorrectionService (task E02/F05/US01/T01, us-01-correction-history AC-1). Task E07/F03/US01/T01 (field-review-correction, ADR-020 screen 6) adds this operation and the sibling GET /api/contracts/{id}/corrections below -- see this document's own provenance paragraph for why. `corrections` accepts only the field names ContractCorrectionService.CorrectableFieldNames lists (type, status, currency, startDate, endDate, effectiveDate, cancellationDeadline, annualSpend, totalContractValue, autoRenewal, renewalTermMonths, paymentTerms, governingLaw); every value is that field's own canonical wire string (dates yyyy-MM-dd, booleans 'true'/'false', decimals/integers via InvariantCulture ToString()) -- ContractCorrectionService's own field table is the single source of truth for parsing/validation, this document does not re-validate. A key present with a JSON null clears an optional field (rejected for a required one, returned as 400); a key absent from the map leaves that field untouched. At least one supplied value must actually differ from the contract's current value, or the whole request fails as 400 (no-op corrections are rejected, never silently accepted). Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation above.

corrections.description: Field name (ContractCorrectionService.CorrectableFieldNames) -> new value (canonical wire string) or null (clear an optional field).

reason.description: Free-text reason, stored verbatim on every affected CorrectionHistory row and on the AuditEntry this write also produces.

200.description: Correction recorded as a new ContractVersion; at least one field actually changed.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, non-GUID id, empty/unknown 'corrections' key, an unparsable value for its field's type, or every supplied value already matches the contract's current value.

404.description: No such contract for this tenant.

get.summary: Correction history for one contract, newest first.
get.description: Maps to GetCorrectionHistoryAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ContractsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by ContractCorrectionHistoryQueryService (task E02/F05/US01/T02, us-01-correction-history AC-2). See the PATCH /api/contracts/{id} operation above for the sibling write path this reads back. Ordered newest-first per field (ContractCorrectionHistoryQueryService.cs's own OrderByDescending(CorrectedAt)) -- the first array entry for a given fieldName is always that field's latest correction. A contract that exists but has never been corrected returns 200 with an empty array, not 404. Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation above.

200.description: Contract found for this tenant (possibly with zero corrections).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a non-GUID id in the route.

404.description: No such contract for this tenant.

get.summary: Actionable renewal pipeline for auto-renewing contracts (facts/recommendations insight card).
get.description: Maps to GetRenewalsAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/RenewalsEndpointExtensions.cs (task E03/F03/US01/T01, us-01-renewal-dashboard-api). Task E07/F02/US01/T01 (contract-360) adds this operation: Contract 360's Overview tab (ADR-020 screen 5) finds this contract's own item in here by contractId to source the real, deterministic (not LLM) recommendedAction/explanation text the Renewals module already computes -- Contigo.Renewals is not otherwise reachable from GET /api/contracts/{id}, and the council decision 'AI recommendation lives in its own labelled block, never mixed with deterministic facts' (us-01-contract-360) needs a real source, not invented UI copy. Only auto-renewing contracts appear here (PortfolioFilter(AutoRenewal:true), applied server-side) -- a non-auto-renewing contract, or one beyond this endpoint's own 100-row page-size ceiling (PortfolioPageRequest.MaxPageSize, honestly surfaced via totalCount), legitimately has no entry; Contract 360's Overview tab renders that as a named gap, not an error. annualUpliftPercent/marketPosition/potentialSavingsRange are always null this wave (need the R3 Benchmark/Savings modules) -- present as explicit null, never fabricated (Appendix C rule 10).

200.description: Tenant-scoped renewal pipeline, up to the underlying portfolio query's own page-size ceiling.

supplierName.description: The supplier's display name, resolved from `supplierId` through `ISupplierNameLookup` over the same portfolio page this pipeline is built from -- never a raw supplier id (R-SUP-04, ADR-024). Null when the contract has no supplier or the id no longer resolves for this tenant. Projected by RenewalsEndpointExtensions.ToPipelineResponse (task E13/F03/US01/T02). See getPortfolio's identical supplierName property above for the full ISupplierNameLookup provenance.

Same resolved display name as the row's own `supplierName` above, repeated inside the insight card because the card is rendered as standalone prose (spec section 9.3) and must not fall back to an id (R-SUP-04, ADR-024).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header.

get.summary: Explainable renewal-priority score breakdown for one contract.
get.description: Maps to GetRenewalPriorityAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/RenewalsEndpointExtensions.cs (task E03/F01/US02/T02, us-02-priority-score). Task E07/F02/US01/T01 (contract-360) adds this operation for the Contract 360 header's 'priority {score}/100' fact-row cell and the Renewal tab's priority-score component table (ADR-020 screen 5: 'Renewal adds priority-score component table'). Unlike GET /api/renewals above, this runs for ANY contract this tenant owns, auto-renewing or not (GetRenewalPriorityAsync composes Contract360QueryService directly, with no AutoRenewal filter) -- so a 200 here does not imply the same contract also has a GET /api/renewals entry. totalScore is always 0-100 under the spec-default component weights and never null (PriorityScoreCalculator.Calculate always returns a value for every component, defaulting an unknown input to its documented no-data value rather than omitting it -- Appendix C rule 10).

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: Contract.Id -- the same id GET /api/contracts/{id} and GET /api/renewals's own contractId use.

200.description: Contract found for this tenant.

totalScore.description: 0-100 under the spec-default weights (5 components, 20 max each).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a non-GUID contractId in the route.

404.description: No such contract for this tenant.

post.summary: Upsert Procurement's own owner/status/action for one renewal.
post.description: Maps to PostRenewalActionAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/RenewalsEndpointExtensions.cs (task E03/F03/US01/T02, renewal-action; parent story us-01-renewal-dashboard-api AC-3: "POST /api/renewals/{id}/action updates owner/status/action"). Task E08/F01/US01/T01 (renewal-pipeline, ADR-020 screen 8) is the first web caller: the insight card's three actions (Start negotiation / Assign to me / Snooze) each upsert the one RenewalAction row for (tenant, contractId) -- see RenewalActionService.SetActionAsync's own doc comment for the upsert-by-(tenant, contractId) semantics and RenewalActionStatus's own doc comment for the closed three-state vocabulary (NotStarted/InProgress/Completed). {id} is the same contractId GET /api/renewals returns per row, not a separate persisted 'renewal id' (RenewalAction's own doc comment: no task has given this module a persisted Renewal entity). Unlike PATCH /api/contracts/{id} or GET /api/renewals/{contractId}/priority above, this never 404s: Contigo.Renewals cannot reference Contigo.Documents.Contracts at all (ADR-002), so a well-formed action against a nonexistent or cross-tenant contract id still upserts a row -- an honest, documented gap named by RenewalsEndpointExtensions' own doc comment, not silently swallowed. This document does not yet expose a GET read-back of the same row: RenewalActionService.GetActionAsync exists but its own doc comment says 'no HTTP route calls this yet'. web/src/routes/renewals/renewalActionStore.ts documents the client-side, session-scoped interim this drives -- the same kind of gap web/src/routes/signin/workspaceStore.ts and web/src/routes/documents/documentStore.ts already establish for their own missing-endpoint gaps.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The renewal's contractId -- the same id GET /api/renewals returns per row.

owner.description: Free-text -- who is tracking this renewal. RenewalActionService.SetActionAsync fails (400) if blank/missing.

status.description: RenewalActionStatus name (NotStarted/InProgress/Completed), case-insensitive. SetActionAsync fails (400) if missing or unrecognized.

action.description: Free-text -- what Procurement is doing/did (e.g. 'In negotiation'). SetActionAsync fails (400) if blank/missing.

200.description: The upserted row's current state.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, non-GUID id, blank owner/action, or an unrecognized status.

post.summary: Upload a supplier quote for line-item extraction.
post.description: Maps to UploadQuoteAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/QuotesEndpointExtensions.cs (task E05/F01/US01/T01, quote-extraction AC-1/AC-2/AC-4), which stores the file (QuoteUploadService) then synchronously runs QuoteExtractionPipeline -- the same hybrid parse/AI-extraction path POST /api/documents uses for contracts, reused verbatim (ADR-017). 'supplier'/'currency'/'geography'/'purchaseDate' are optional form fields (task E05/F02/US01/T01, market-assessment): a quote uploaded without them is stored and extracted normally but every line's GET .../assessment call reports MarketAssessmentStatus.QuoteDataUnresolved (Quote.cs's own doc comment -- 'insufficient data is an honest, expected outcome', never a fabricated match). Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as POST /api/documents.

supplier.description: Optional supplier/vendor name -- Quote.Supplier, one of the four BenchmarkQuery dimensions.

purchaseDate.description: Optional quote/purchase date -- Quote.PurchaseDate; defaults server-side to the upload date when omitted.

201.description: Stored and processed synchronously (extraction, normalization, SKU matching all run before responding).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, a non-multipart body, an empty/missing 'file' field, an unparsable 'purchaseDate', or QuoteUploadService.UploadAsync's Result.Error.

get.summary: Line-level market assessment for one quote (benchmark position, confidence/provenance, recommended target + potential saving).
get.description: Maps to GetAssessmentAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/QuotesEndpointExtensions.cs (task E05/F02/US01/T01, market-assessment AC-3; task E05/F02/US01/T02, target-saving AC-2's 'recommended target range + potential saving' half), backed by MarketAssessmentService.AssessAsync. One entry per QuoteLine, in extraction order. 'position' is deliberately NOT declared with 'enum' here even though Contigo.Quotes.Domain.MarketPosition is a closed 3-value set (BelowMarket/InLine/AboveMarket): web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs#renderSchemaType drops a nullable union's null member whenever the schema also declares enum (the same generator limitation PortfolioListItem.risk and Contract360's header.risk/clauses[].riskLevel already worked around) -- 'position' is null exactly when 'status' is not Assessed, so it must stay nullable. web/src/api/client.ts names the real value set as its own hand-written QuoteMarketPosition alias plus an isQuoteMarketPosition runtime guard, the same pattern PortfolioRiskSeverity/isPortfolioRiskSeverity already establish. Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as POST /api/quotes above.

200.description: Quote found for this tenant.

position.description: BelowMarket | InLine | AboveMarket when present -- see this operation's own description for why 'enum' is not declared here.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or a non-GUID id in the route.

404.description: No quote found for this tenant -- MarketAssessmentService.AssessAsync's Result.Error, unlike GET /api/contracts/{id}'s bare Results.NotFound(), IS forwarded as the response body here (QuotesEndpointExtensions.GetAssessmentAsync calls Results.NotFound(result.Error)).

post.summary: Apply manual SKU-to-product mapping corrections, then re-run normalization and re-read the assessment.
post.description: Maps to RecalculateAssessmentAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/QuotesEndpointExtensions.cs (task E05/F01/US02/T02, sku-recalculate; parent story us-02-sku-normalization AC-2's 'allow manual product mapping' half, AC-3 're-run assessment after mapping correction'), backed by SkuMappingService.RecalculateAsync. 'mappings' may be an empty array -- SkuMappingService's own doc comment names this a valid 'pure refresh' call (re-reads the current unmatched-line list and a fresh assessment with no new correction), which web/src/routes/quotes/ uses as its own read path for the Extract/Assessment steps (there is no separate GET that returns unmatchedLines). Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as POST /api/quotes above.

sku.description: The raw, as-extracted SKU text (QuoteLine.Sku) this correction resolves.

200.description: Quote found for this tenant; mappings (if any) applied, normalization + assessment re-run.

unmatchedLines.description: Every line still SkuMatchStatus.Unmatched after this call's own (possibly zero) corrections -- AC-4's gate for web/src/routes/quotes/ is exactly 'unmatchedLines.length > 0'.

assessment.description: Identical shape to GET /api/quotes/{id}/assessment's own 200 body -- duplicated here, not $ref'd (web/scripts/generate-api-client.mjs has no $ref support; see its own header comment).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, non-GUID id, or a blank 'sku'/'canonicalSku' on a supplied correction.

404.description: No quote found for this tenant (SkuMappingService.QuoteNotFoundError, forwarded as the response body).

post.summary: Record a quote's final negotiated outcome.
post.description: Maps to CaptureOutcomeAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/NegotiationsEndpointExtensions.cs (task E05/F03/US02/T01, negotiation-outcome; parent story us-02-outcome-capture AC-1; task E05/F03/US02/T02, outcome-propagation AC-2 adds the optional savingsOpportunityId/savingsPropagated/savingsPropagationError fields), backed by NegotiationOutcomeService.CaptureAsync. realizedSaving/discountPercent are always server-computed (NegotiationOutcomeCalculator.Compute: realizedSaving = originalQuoteTotal - finalPrice, discountPercent = realizedSaving / originalQuoteTotal * 100) -- never caller-supplied, so this operation's request body does not accept either. 'leversUsed' entries must each name a Contigo.Quotes.Application.Strategy.NegotiationLeverType member (case-insensitive); NegotiationOutcomeService.LeversUsedInvalidError lists the exact set on a 400. web/src/routes/quotes/ has no way to fetch spec's own AI-generated lever recommendations/evidence over HTTP -- Contigo.Quotes.Application.Strategy.NegotiationStrategyService (task E05/F03/US01/T01, negotiation-strategy) computes exactly that, fully unit-tested, but backend/src/Contigo.Api/Program.cs never maps an endpoint for it (checked: no MapGet/MapPost anywhere in backend/src/Contigo.Api references NegotiationStrategyService/NegotiationStrategyCalculator/QuoteNegotiationStrategy) -- a genuine, pre-existing backend gap, not one this task's contigo-web file scope can close. Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation above.

201.description: Outcome captured (and, when savingsOpportunityId was supplied, best-effort propagated to Contigo.Savings -- its own success/failure never turns an already-durable capture into an HTTP error).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, or NegotiationOutcomeService.CaptureAsync's Result.Error (non-positive originalQuoteTotal/finalPrice, negative targetPrice, negative negotiationDurationDays, empty/invalid leversUsed).

404.description: No quote found for this tenant (NegotiationOutcomeService.QuoteNotFoundError, forwarded as the response body).

post.summary: Ask Contigo: route a natural-language question and answer it with citations, or abstain.
post.description: Maps to PostChatQueryAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ChatEndpointExtensions.cs (task E02/F04/US01/T01 query-router, E02/F04/US02/T01 rag-citations, E02/F04/US02/T02 abstain-guard; product spec §8.3/§8.4). Task E07/F04/US01/T01 (ask-contigo-ui, ADR-020 screen 7) adds this operation -- see this document's own info.description for the full provenance/gap notes (Structured-not-wired message, Semantic-abstain reason, and the Document-vs-Clause citation-lookup gap). Same interim X-Tenant-Id header placeholder as every other operation above.

question.description: The user's natural-language question. A blank/whitespace-only value is rejected as 400.

200.description: Always 200 once routing succeeds -- the Structured-not-wired and the Semantic answer/abstain outcomes are both valid, expected shapes of the same envelope, never an error.

documentId.description: Composite SourceType:SourceId (e.g. Document:<guid> or Clause:<guid>) -- see this document's own info.description.

page.description: Always null today -- Embedding carries no page column yet (ChatEndpointExtensions.ToEvidenceSnippet).

section.description: Real chunk position (e.g. 'chunk 2'), not a document section number.

message.description: Non-null only for the Structured-not-wired case -- see this document's own info.description.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header, a blank question, or a retrieval/answer failure (EmbeddingRetrievalService/RagAnswerService Result.Error).

get.summary: Procurement-homepage KPI row: spend/contracts/renewals plus the three savings buckets.
get.description: Maps to GetSavingsKpisAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/SavingsKpiEndpointExtensions.cs (task E04/F03/US01/T01, us-01-savings-kpis AC-1; product spec section 10.1's six-row KPI table). Task E08/F02/US01/T01 (savings-home, ADR-020 screen 9) adds this operation -- the fifth web epic to extend this document (see this document's own info.description 'repeating chore' provenance paragraph). 'Annual spend analyzed'/'Contracts analyzed' come from Contigo.Documents.Contracts (PortfolioQueryService.GetAnalysisSummaryAsync); 'Savings identified'/'Savings in progress'/'Savings realized' come from Contigo.Savings (SavingsKpiQueryService.GetSummaryAsync); 'Upcoming renewals' reuses GET /api/renewals's own auto-renewing candidate query rather than rebuilding the full pipeline just to count it (see that endpoint's own C# doc comment for the full reasoning) -- this operation never calls Contigo.Benchmark directly, so a benchmark-provider outage cannot surface as a distinct HTTP status here; the web client's own 'benchmark provider unreachable' Home-screen state (screens.md #9) is this call failing for any reason, not a status code this endpoint reserves for that cause specifically. Each spend/savings figure is grouped by currency, never summed across currencies (this codebase has no currency-conversion service) -- an empty array is the honest zero-contracts/zero-opportunities answer, never a fabricated zero-currency row.

200.description: Tenant-scoped KPI summary.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header.

get.summary: Home screen's opportunities table: every SavingsOpportunity for the caller's tenant, newest identified first.
get.description: Maps to GetSavingsOpportunitiesAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/SavingsEndpointExtensions.cs (task E04/F02/US02/T01 savings-opportunity, task E04/F03/US01/T02 savings-list AC-3 confidenceLevel). Task E08/F02/US01/T01 (savings-home, ADR-020 screen 9) adds this operation's GET half -- the fifth web epic to extend this document (see this document's own info.description 'repeating chore' provenance paragraph); PATCH /api/savings/{id} (status/owner/realized-value edits) already exists on the backend but has no screen in this task's own AC that needs it, so it stays undocumented here until a future editing surface has a real caller (the same 'wiring lands with the first real caller' convention this codebase already follows elsewhere). Never 404s -- an empty items array is a tenant's own honest, valid 'no opportunities yet' answer. confidenceLevel/status are real, closed three-value enums (SavingsConfidenceLevel.ToString() / SavingsOpportunityStatus.ToString()), declared with enum the same way GET /api/renewals's own status field already is. type is free text (Domain.SavingsOpportunity.Type's own doc comment: no ADR/spec fixes a vocabulary for it).

200.description: Tenant-scoped opportunity list, newest identified first.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id header.

get.summary: The caller's last N conversations (rail resume list).
get.description: Maps to GetConversationsAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ConversationsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by ConversationService.ListRecentAsync (task E13/F05/US01/T02, us-01-conversations; R-CONV-02 'the rail shows the user's last 5 conversations, resume by click'). Bare array response, not a {items,totalCount} envelope -- there is no paging concept for 'my last N conversations'. Optional ?take= overrides ConversationService.DefaultRecentLimit (5); web/src/api/client.ts#listConversations never sends it, always taking the backend default. Caller identity (task E13/F09/US01/T04, ADR-022/OQ-askv2-005/R-CONV-03): X-User-Id is required in addition to X-Tenant-Id on every operation under /api/conversations -- ConversationsEndpointExtensions.TryResolveUserId prefers an authenticated ClaimsPrincipal's subject claim (the ADR-010 end state; never true today, nothing wires AddAuthentication yet) and otherwise requires this header, the MSAL account username, non-authoritative until the API JWT lands. A 400 covers a missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id, a missing X-User-Id, or a malformed ?take=.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: MSAL account username (ADR-022 Day-1 posture; OQ-askv2-005; R-CONV-03). Non-authoritative -- replaced by the token subject once ADR-010's API JWT lands. Required on every /api/conversations* operation.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Overrides ConversationService.DefaultRecentLimit (5) when supplied; must be a positive integer.

200.description: The caller's own conversations in this tenant, most-recently-updated first, capped at `take`/the default limit.

title.description: The first question, <=48 chars (ConversationService.TitleMaxLength), or the literal 'New chat' (ConversationService.DefaultTitle) until the first message lands.

scopeContractId.description: Set when this conversation was opened from Contract 360 'Ask about it' (/ask?scope=); null for a plain new chat.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id or X-User-Id header, or a non-positive-integer 'take'.

post.summary: Starts a new conversation, optionally scoped to a contract.
post.description: Maps to PostConversationAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ConversationsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by ConversationService.CreateAsync (task E13/F05/US01/T02; R-CONV-01/R-CONV-02; ADR-024 'the global Ask bar always opens a new chat'). Request body is ConversationsEndpointExtensions.CreateConversationRequest, hand-written in web/src/api/client.ts (the generator does not parse requestBody -- see this document's own 'Codegen tool choice' paragraph): `{ scopeContractId? }`, a GUID string. An absent/blank scopeContractId opens a plain new chat (title defaults to 'New chat' until the first question lands); a well-formed one scopes it to that contract (Contract 360's 'Ask about it', /ask?scope=<contractId>). A malformed (non-GUID) scopeContractId is a 400, not silently dropped. Same X-Tenant-Id/X-User-Id pair as GET /api/conversations above.

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id or X-User-Id header, or a non-GUID scopeContractId.

get.summary: One conversation, with every turn, oldest first.
get.description: Maps to GetConversationAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ConversationsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by ConversationService.GetAsync (task E13/F05/US01/T02; R-CONV-02 AC-1 'resuming a conversation renders past turns with citation cards and actions still clickable'). 404, never 403, whether {id} does not exist, belongs to another tenant (RLS backstop, ADR-009), or belongs to another user of the same tenant (an application-level filter -- ConversationService's own doc comment: 'RLS has no per-user predicate') -- one honest outcome, never a distinguishing signal (AC-1/AC-2 'another user/tenant cannot list or read the conversation'). Each message's citations/actions are the identical shapes POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages returns (duplicated, not $ref'd -- this document has no $ref/oneOf support, see its own 'Codegen tool choice' paragraph) EXCEPT a stored message never carries `followUps` -- ConversationMessage has no such column (ConversationsEndpointExtensions.ToMessageResponse's own field list), so a resumed conversation's past Contigo turns render without follow-up chips, an honest, real limitation, not an oversight.

200.description: The conversation and its messages, oldest first.

markdown.description: The caller's own question verbatim for a 'you' turn; Contigo's answerMarkdown for a 'contigo' turn.

corpus.description: Usually 'tenant' | 'market' | 'contigo' (requirements.md §6 / R-WEB-04's three-corpus citation-badge vocabulary). Backend truth (Contigo.Chat.Application.Reply.ReplyCitation.Corpus's own doc comment: 'Echoes PackItem.Corpus') admits a fourth internal value, 'calc' (a deterministic-calculator-derived fact -- a renewal date, a negotiation lever, a criticality score -- Contigo.Chat.Application.Pack.PackCorpus.Calc), with no remapping step anywhere before the wire; confirmed by reading backend/src/Contigo.Api/AskCopilotService.cs's own PackItem constructions for 'when-you-must-move'/lever/target/criticality items, which set a real /contracts/{id} Href despite PackItem.Href's own doc comment claiming Href is null for PackCorpus.Calc. Left a plain string (not `enum`) to stay honest about this observed gap rather than declare a fourth badge variant replyTypes.ts does not have; web/src/routes/ask/askViewModel.ts#toCitationCorpus folds an unrecognised value into 'tenant' (the closer honest bucket -- a calculator fact is always about this tenant's own contract, never a market/feature fact).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id or X-User-Id header, or a non-GUID id in the route.

404.description: No such conversation for this tenant and caller (unknown id, another tenant's, or another user's -- one honest outcome, see this operation's own description).

post.summary: Asks a question in an existing conversation; runs the Ask engine and returns the reply.
post.description: Maps to PostConversationMessageAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/ConversationsEndpointExtensions.cs -- the one endpoint that actually runs the Ask engine (Contigo.Api.AskCopilotService.AskAsync, task E13/F06/US01/T01), then persists both the caller's question and Contigo's reply (ConversationService.AppendMessageAsync) before wire-shaping the same object back (shared with POST /api/chat/query's own alias, ConversationsEndpointExtensions.AskAndAppendAsync). Request body `{ question }` (ConversationsEndpointExtensions.PostConversationMessageRequest, hand-written client-side, see this document's 'Codegen tool choice' paragraph). Reply shape is ADR-024 §6 / inputs/requirements.md §6, kind decides the layout: `answer` (markdown + citations + actions + followUps), `abstain` (a true-insufficiency reply, citations/actions/followUps empty), `redirect` (greeting/off-domain/needs_document, one CTA), `refusal` (legal, one CTA). `actions[].kind` is 'navigate' | 'upload' (Contigo.Chat.Application.Capabilities.CopilotActionKind) -- inputs/requirements.md §6's own JSON example shows 'primary'/'secondary' instead, an illustrative visual-priority label the real backend never emits; web/src/routes/ask/askViewModel.ts maps the real navigate/upload/index-ordered actions onto ReplyAction's presentational primary/secondary at the UI boundary (replyTypes.ts, task E13/F09/US01/T02, is out of this task's file scope to change). See GET /api/conversations/{id} above for why `corpus` is a plain string, not a 3-value enum. 404 under the identical tenant/user/unknown-id rule GET /api/conversations/{id} documents.

200.description: The routed reply -- always 200 once the conversation is confirmed to exist, per ChatEndpointExtensions' own long-standing convention for this same composition root; an abstain/redirect/refusal is a successful, honest answer, not an error status.

answerMarkdown.description: Narrated prose with inline [n] markers; empty for abstain/redirect/refusal? no -- redirect/refusal still carry warm prose here (R-ASK-07); only truly nothing to narrate is empty.

corpus.description: See GET /api/conversations/{id} above's identical citations[].corpus for the full 'tenant/market/contigo, occasionally calc' provenance note.

href.description: A tenant citation's own destination -- observed backend behaviour (AskCopilotService.cs's PackItem constructions) always sets this to the bare `/contracts/{contractId}`, never `/contracts/{contractId}?clause=...`, despite inputs/requirements.md §6's own illustrative example showing a `?clause=` suffix. web/src/routes/ask/askViewModel.ts appends `?page={page}` itself (when `page` is present) before navigating, reusing web/src/routes/contracts/contract360/contract360ViewModel.ts#resolveHighlightedClauseId's existing page-based clause lookup -- a `?clause=` deep link cannot be built client-side today because no citation field carries a raw clauseId (R-ASK-08 'no guids ever rendered' -- consistent with that, not a client oversight).

400.description: Missing/invalid X-Tenant-Id or X-User-Id header, a non-GUID id in the route, or a blank 'question'.

get.description: Maps to GetCapabilities in backend/src/Contigo.Api/CapabilitiesEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by the static Contigo.Chat.Application.Capabilities.CapabilityCatalog (task E13/F08/US01/T01, story us-01-capability-catalog AC-1; R-SYS-01). No X-Tenant-Id: the catalog is static, tenant-agnostic metadata, the same 'no tenant boundary to enforce' reasoning GET /api/market/records/{id} below shares. Role-aware: an admin-gated entry (Workspace & members) is hidden unless the optional X-Role header resolves to Admin (WorkspaceRoleClaimResolver.TryResolve, accepts 'Admin'/'Workspace Admin'/'Contigo.Admin'/...); a missing/unparseable/non-Admin header fails closed (hides it), never a 401/403 -- the catalog itself is not sensitive. web/src/routes/ask/index.tsx / web/src/components/ask-bar/askSuggestions.ts (task E13/F09/US01/T04) read only `capabilities[].exampleQuestions` for the two-chip suggestions this task adds; `CapabilityCatalog.SuggestionsFor`'s own richer per-screen/supplier-templated chip copy (app.jsx `chipsFor`/`c360Chips`) is a backend-internal helper with no HTTP surface at all -- this task reproduces the two prototype-verbatim supplier-templated strings client-side for the Contract-360-scoped case (askViewModel.ts) rather than inventing a new endpoint for them.

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: Optional. Gates the one Admin-only catalog entry. This client (web/src/api/client.ts#getCapabilities) never sends it -- suggestion chips only read exampleQuestions, which every capability carries regardless of roleGate.

200.description: The full, role-filtered catalog.

routePattern.description: May carry an unresolved '{...}' placeholder (e.g. '/contracts/{contractId}') -- a route template, not always a complete href.

get.summary: One market-intelligence record, for the Ask citation side panel.
get.description: R-EVD-02 / requirements.md §6 API table: 'one market record (for the citation panel)'; parent story us-01-market-intelligence AC-5: 'returns one record with its provenance label and updatedAt for the citation panel'. No X-Tenant-Id: the market index is shared and read-only for every tenant (ADR-024 'three sources, one rule'), the same 'no authorization boundary to enforce' reasoning GET /api/capabilities above shares. Task E13/F06/US01/T01 (ask-engine) is this route's first writer (backend/src/Contigo.Api/MarketEndpointExtensions.cs); as of this task's own commit that file does not compile (two competing method bodies concatenated mid-statement -- a dangling `if` referencing an out-of-scope `endpoints` variable, a duplicate `deal` local, ~11 duplicate anonymous-object property names), which breaks the whole Contigo.Api assembly, and no Contigo.Api.Tests file exists for this route either. Rather than block this web task on a backend defect outside its own 'Files to create or modify' (backend/**), this operation is authored directly from the task's own coding-objective field list ('title, category, geography, band, provenance label, updatedAt') plus the real, clean, unbroken domain types it is built from: Contigo.Market.Contracts.MarketDeal (record shape), Contigo.Market.Retrieval.MarketNoteComposer.Compose (title/category/geography/provenance/updatedAt -- BuildTitle: '{Supplier} · {Product}'), Contigo.Market.Contracts.MarketProvenance.Label ('representative market data · mock feed · updated yyyy-MM-dd'). `band` is this task's own addition, not named on MarketNote -- the three real percentile prices (MarketDeal.UnitPriceP25/P50/P75) plus Currency, structured rather than left as the citation card's own prose snippet (which already exists separately on the citation, ReplyCitation.Snippet). Once F02/T02's persisted `market_record` store and a fixed MarketEndpointExtensions.cs land, whichever lands last should diff its real response against this document rather than assume a silent match (the same rule this document's own info.description already states for Documents V2).

200.description: The record.

title.description: MarketNoteComposer.BuildTitle: '{Supplier} · {Product}', or '{Supplier} · {Product} ({Sku})' when a SKU is recorded.

provenance.description: MarketProvenance.Label(deal), e.g. 'representative market data · mock feed · updated 2026-09-01'.

404.description: No market record with this id.

get.summary: Ranked criticality score for every contract in the tenant, with explained components.
get.description: Maps to GetCriticalityAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/InsightsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by Contigo.Insights.Criticality.CriticalityScoreCalculator (task E13/F07/US01/T01, story us-01-insights; R-PORT-01). Documented here for contract completeness (this document's own 'repeating chore' -- every landed operation gets an entry) -- task E13/F09/US01/T04 (web-ask-v2) does not add a web/src/api/client.ts wrapper for it: the Ask engine's own portfolio-strategy pack composition (backend/src/Contigo.Api/AskCopilotService.cs) calls this composition's own methods directly and narrates the numbers into the reply; no screen in this task's own coding objective renders a standalone criticality ranking. A future task that builds one can add getCriticality to client.ts against this same, already-documented shape.

200.description: Every contract's criticality score, portfolio order (not pre-sorted by score).

get.summary: The renewal-strategy pack for one contract -- the same numbers Ask narrates.
get.description: Maps to GetContractStrategyAsync in backend/src/Contigo.Api/InsightsEndpointExtensions.cs, backed by Contigo.Insights.Strategy.StrategyPackBuilder (task E13/F07/US01/T01, story us-01-insights AC-3/AC-4; R-STR-01). Documented here for contract completeness, the same 'repeating chore' as GET /api/insights/criticality above -- task E13/F09/US01/T04 (web-ask-v2) does not add a client.ts wrapper: AskCopilotService composes this pack internally for the Ask reply's own 'renewal strategy' narration; no screen in this task's own coding objective renders it standalone. `whenYouMustMove`/`targets` dates and amounts are frequently null (no renewal/cancellation date yet, or no benchmark match -- StrategyInputs.SupplierName is always null today per that type's own doc comment, so no priced-line target ever resolves a real benchmark), an honest 'insufficient market data'/'not yet available' outcome per R-STR-01 AC-3, never a fabricated number.

200.description: The strategy pack.
